Helping pet parents understand the emotions behind the behaviour. I’m Dr. Serena, a Small Animal Veterinarian and Behaviour Resident in BC, Canada. My mission is to improve the Quality of Life for both pets and their caregivers by filtering out myths and focusing on science-backed evidence.

#veterinarybehavior #dogbehavior #CanadianVeterinarian #veterinarypsychiatry #BCVets #QualityOfLife #EvidenceBased
